days.title: Northern Lagoons and River Woods
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: laguna de las Ollas
stops.detail: The Ollas lagoon is the smallest of all those in the delta, is very low in salt and is separated from the sea by a sandbar.

stops.name: laguna del Canal Viejo
stops.detail: The Canal Viejo lagoon has three different basins and has an abundant belt of helophytic vegetation.

stops.name: isla de Gracia
stops.detail: The vegetation occupying the riverbanks belongs to the so-called riverside vegetation (populetalia and nerio tamaricetea) and corresponds to the delta's only forest communities, the well-known riverside forests, among which the poplar grove (Populus alba) stands out, especially present on Gracia Island.

days.title: Buda Island and Coastal Marshes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: isla de Buda
stops.detail: Buda Island has a central lagoon of considerable size and small lagoons immersed in a dense reedbed locally known as "quemados".

stops.name: Alfacada
stops.detail: Alfacada is a small lagoon close to the Mediodía gorge.

stops.name: Platjola
stops.detail: Platjola is an elongated lagoon of small size that communicates with the sea and is what remains of an old river mouth.

days.title: Southern Salt Lakes and Points
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: la Cerrada
stops.detail: La Cerrada, as its name suggests, has no natural direct communication with the sea, but it does come into contact with the bay through man-made ditches and canals.

stops.name: la Encanyissada
stops.detail: La Encanyissada is the lagoon closest to the town of San Carlos de la Rápita and is the largest of all those in the Ebro Delta.

stops.name: Punta del Cuerno
stops.detail: The halophilic vegetation of saline terrains or arthrocnemetea groups plant communities well represented near the salt flats of San Antonio, in la Cerrada, and in those of Trinidad, in the Punta del Cuerno.
